limitations: The public dynamic model resolver cannot receive a typed per-step or per-attempt identifier.
The stable public stream event id is produced after the resolver must select the live model.
Runtime context is telemetry metadata and is not a supported HTTP transport contract.
nonClaims: No application code, proxy configuration, deployment, provider request, credential, or Production state changed.
No raw Eve session, turn, step, event, attempt, prompt, response, token, header, or trace value is retained.
This does not rule out a future public Eve API that provides the required correlation value.

recovery.required: A future Eve public API must provide a stable per-attempt or logical-step value to the actual LanguageModel request.
